mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'

The project's current recorded decision is to use zstd as the compression codec, chosen for its better compression ratio and faster decompression. This applies wherever the project compresses data, including transport.
EOF
cat docs/policies/compression.md
